source_deviations: The source is a single image with no text; the lesson is written from Twitter's open-source READMEs instead and does not describe the image.
The READMEs date only FlockDB's figures (April 2010) and Snowflake's first release (2010); the 2012 and 2022 labels of the title are not confirmed by them.
The Twitter engineering blog was not reachable from the authoring environment and was not read.
